newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Metal Exchange to close for lunar holiday.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Metal Exchange to close for lunar holiday.

text.p: The Shanghai Metal Exchange will close for two weeks from February 3 to February 14 over the Chinese Lunar New Year holiday and trading will resume on February 17, an exchange statement said on Friday.

The last trading session for the February 1997 contract will be moved from the normal date of February 15 to February 20, the delivery day to February 25 and the last physical acceptance day to March 5, the statement said.
